users.planRequirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2

evidence.quote: Retrieve a list of user objects.
The default and maximum page sizes are 100 and 999 user objects respectively
Get the last signed-in date and request ID of the sign-in for a given user.
Details for the signInActivity property require a Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 license and the AuditLog.Read.All permission.

assumptions: The source does not give the OAuth token address, so only a bearer-token method is listed. In practice an app registration (client credentials) would be better because it survives staff leaving, but its token URL was not in the source.
The source says to use paging but does not name the next-page field. I assumed the standard Microsoft Graph field '@odata.nextLink'.
Page size is set to 500, the documented maximum when signInActivity is requested.

Last sign-in data (signInActivity) needs Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 and the AuditLog.Read.All permission. Without that licence the user request may fail or return no activity data, so I marked the users call as requiring it.
The source does not list the OAuth permission names for app-only access in a single place; I used User.Read.All and AuditLog.Read.All from the text.

Account status is derived from accountEnabled only (true = active, false = inactive). Users deleted in the last 30 days are on a separate endpoint not detailed in the source, so they are not included.
No role field is available on the user list, so role is left empty.
Rate limits are not stated in the source, so they are left empty.
Guests are classed by userType (Member or Guest); service accounts cannot be told apart from the data given.
